title: Web Summit 2026: Brasil chega a Lisboa com 200 empresas a procura de investimento (IOL, Link To Leaders, 5 November 2026)
what_it_says: IOL, with Link To Leaders and from an ApexBrasil statement, reports the Brazilian delegation, the Brazil Pavilion, and that the startups for the Lisbon Incubation Programme are announced on 10 November.
